aboutPage.metaTitle: About Us — Handmade Jewelry with Heart
aboutPage.metaDescription: Meet the maker behind our handcrafted jewelry. Learn how each piece is made by hand using ethically sourced sterling silver and natural gemstones.
aboutPage.heroTitle: Made by hand, worn with heart
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Each piece is crafted one at a time — never mass-produced, never rushed.
aboutPage.storyParagraph1: It started with a passion for creating something real. Not perfect, but real — made by hand, with intention, and with care for the person who would one day wear it.
aboutPage.storyParagraph2: Every ring, necklace, and bracelet in our collection is handmade in a small studio. No factories, no assembly lines. Just time, skill, and a commitment to craft.
aboutPage.processStep1Description: Every piece starts as a sketch — inspired by nature, geometry, and the beauty of imperfection.
aboutPage.processStep2Description: Sterling silver is cut, shaped, and soldered by hand using traditional jeweler's tools.
aboutPage.processStep3Description: Natural gemstones are set one by one — each chosen for its unique color and character.
aboutPage.processStep4Description: Each piece is polished, inspected, and carefully packaged for its new home.
aboutPage.materialsSilverDescription: We use .925 sterling silver for durability and a beautiful finish that lasts for years.
aboutPage.materialsGemstonesDescription: From moonstone to labradorite, our stones are ethically sourced and selected by hand.
aboutPage.materialsFinishDescription: All orders ship in recycled kraft boxes with seed paper cards you can plant.
aboutPage.valuesCraftDescription: Quality over quantity — always. We take the time each piece deserves.
aboutPage.valuesSustainabilityDescription: Ethically sourced materials, minimal waste, and packaging that gives back to the earth.
aboutPage.valuesConnectionDescription: Jewelry is personal. We want every customer to feel that when they open the box.
aboutPage.imageAlt: Handcrafted jewelry being made in a small studio

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: Please read these Terms of Service ("Terms") carefully before placing an order or using the Handmade Jewelry Store website ("Site"). By accessing the Site or completing a purchase, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site.
termsPage.s1Item1: All jewelry is handmade to order. Slight variations in color, texture, and dimensions are inherent to the handmade process and are not considered defects.
termsPage.s1Item2: Product images are representative. Actual appearance may differ slightly due to monitor calibration and natural variation in gemstones and metals.
termsPage.s1Item3: We reserve the right to cancel an order at any time if we are unable to fulfill it (for example, due to material unavailability). In such cases, a full refund will be issued promptly.
termsPage.s1Item4: By placing an order, you confirm that the information you provide (name, shipping address, payment details) is accurate and complete.
termsPage.s2Item1: All prices are displayed in US Dollars (USD) and do not include applicable taxes.
termsPage.s2Item2: Sales tax may be applied at checkout depending on your shipping address and applicable local laws.
termsPage.s2Item3: Payment is processed securely by Stripe. We accept major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and select buy-now-pay-later options (Klarna, Afterpay).
termsPage.s2Item4: Your card is charged at the time of order placement. We do not store your full payment card details.
termsPage.s2Item5: Prices are subject to change without notice. The price displayed at the time of order confirmation is final for that order.
termsPage.s3Item1: Each piece is handcrafted after your order is placed. Production typically takes 5–10 business days before shipment.
termsPage.s3Item2: Estimated delivery times are provided for reference only and are not guaranteed. Delays caused by carriers, customs, or events outside our control are not our responsibility.
termsPage.s3Item3: We ship to addresses within the United States and internationally. International orders may be subject to import duties and taxes levied by the destination country, which are the buyer's responsibility.
termsPage.s3Item4: Risk of loss passes to you upon confirmed delivery to your address. If a package is lost in transit before delivery, please contact us and we will work with the carrier to resolve the issue or issue a replacement or refund.
termsPage.s4Item1: We accept returns within 14 days of delivery. Items should be returned unworn and undamaged; original packaging is appreciated but not required.
termsPage.s4Item2: Custom or personalized pieces (engraved, resized to a specific size on request) are exempt from our standard return policy unless they arrive defective or damaged. EU consumers retain statutory rights under applicable consumer protection law regardless of this policy.
termsPage.s4Item3: To initiate a return, contact us at {email} within the return window with your order number and reason for return.
termsPage.s4Item4: Return shipping costs are the buyer's responsibility unless the item arrived damaged or incorrect.
termsPage.s4Item5: Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. Original outbound shipping costs are refunded for defective or incorrect items.

privacyPage.metaDescription: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information at Senichka.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Handmade Jewelry Store ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit our website or make a purchase. By using our site, you agree to the practices described here.
privacyPage.s1Item1: Account information — name, email address, and password when you create an account.
privacyPage.s1Item2: Order information — shipping address, billing details, and purchase history when you place an order.
privacyPage.s1Item3: Payment information — processed securely by Stripe. We never store your full card number.
privacyPage.s1Item4: Contact messages — name, email, and message content when you use our contact form.
privacyPage.s1Item5: Usage data — pages visited, time on site, and browser/device type via analytics tools (see Section 4).
privacyPage.s2Item1: To process and fulfill your orders, including shipping notifications.
privacyPage.s2Item2: To send transactional emails (order confirmations, shipping updates).
privacyPage.s2Item3: To respond to your support and contact inquiries.
privacyPage.s2Item4: To send marketing emails if you have opted in (you can unsubscribe at any time).
privacyPage.s2Item5: To improve the website and understand how visitors use it.
privacyPage.s2Item6: To prevent fraud and maintain security.
privacyPage.s3Intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share information only with trusted service providers necessary to operate our store:
privacyPage.s3Stripe: Stripe — payment processing. Subject to Stripe's Privacy Policy.
privacyPage.s3Resend: Resend — transactional email delivery (order confirmations, password resets).
privacyPage.s3Klaviyo: Klaviyo — email marketing, only if you have opted in to marketing communications.
privacyPage.s3Carriers: Shipping carriers — your name and delivery address are shared with the carrier fulfilling your order.
privacyPage.s4Intro: We use the following tools to understand how visitors use our site. These tools may set cookies and collect usage data. They are only activated after you provide cookie consent.
privacyPage.s4GA4: Google Analytics 4 — aggregate site traffic and e-commerce analytics.
privacyPage.s4Clarity: Microsoft Clarity — session recordings and heatmaps to improve UX.
privacyPage.s4FBPixel: Facebook Pixel — conversion tracking for Facebook and Instagram advertising.
privacyPage.s5Intro: We use the following types of cookies:
privacyPage.s5Necessary: Strictly necessary — required for the site to function (cart, session, security). Cannot be disabled.
privacyPage.s5Analytics: Analytics — help us understand how the site is used. Require your consent.
privacyPage.s5Marketing: Marketing — used for advertising and remarketing. Require your consent.
privacyPage.s5Outro: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time via the cookie consent banner or your browser settings.
privacyPage.s6Body: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. Order data is retained for 7 years for tax and accounting purposes. Account data is retained until you request deletion. Marketing consent records are retained until you withdraw consent.
privacyPage.s7Intro: Depending on where you live, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacyPage.s7Access: Access — request a copy of the data we hold about you.
privacyPage.s7Correction: Correction — ask us to correct inaccurate data.
privacyPage.s7Deletion: Deletion — request that we delete your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
privacyPage.s7Portability: Portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format.
privacyPage.s7OptOut: Opt-out of sale — California residents: we do not sell personal data.
privacyPage.s7Withdraw: Withdraw consent — withdraw marketing or analytics consent at any time.
privacyPage.s7Outro: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}. We will respond within 30 days.
privacyPage.s8Body: We use industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, bcrypt password hashing, and secure payment processing via Stripe. No method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your data.
privacyPage.s9Body: Our website is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with their information, please contact us and we will delete it.
privacyPage.s10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Your continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacyPage.s11Intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

ringSizeGuide.metaTitle: Ring Size Guide — US, EU, UK Conversion · Senichka
ringSizeGuide.metaDescription: Find your ring size with our conversion chart and step-by-step measuring guide. US, EU, UK sizes plus inner diameter in millimeters.
ringSizeGuide.title: Ring Size Guide
ringSizeGuide.subtitle: Measure once, wear forever. A clean conversion table and three reliable ways to find your size at home.
ringSizeGuide.howToMeasureTitle: How to measure your ring size
ringSizeGuide.methodExistingRingTitle: Use a ring you already own
ringSizeGuide.methodExistingRingBody: Pick a ring that fits the intended finger comfortably. Place it on a millimeter ruler and measure the inner diameter from edge to edge. Match the diameter to the table below.
ringSizeGuide.methodPaperStripBody: Cut a thin strip of paper about 80 mm long. Wrap it snugly around the base of your finger and mark where the ends overlap. Measure the length in millimeters — that's your inner circumference (the EU size).
ringSizeGuide.methodJewelerBody: Most jewelers will size your finger for free in under a minute. The most accurate option, especially for engagement rings or gifts.
ringSizeGuide.conversionTableSubtitle: EU is the inner circumference in mm. UK uses letters. Diameter is the inner ring opening.
ringSizeGuide.tableCaption: Ring size conversion: US, UK, EU, and inner diameter in millimeters.
ringSizeGuide.tipMeasureWarm: Measure at the end of the day or when your hands are warm — fingers swell slightly when warm.
ringSizeGuide.tipMeasureMultiple: Measure two or three times and use the largest result — a ring should slide on but not fly off.
ringSizeGuide.tipKnuckleSize: If your knuckle is much wider than the base of your finger, size up by half so the ring passes over comfortably.
ringSizeGuide.tipBetweenSizes: When in between sizes, choose the larger one — easier to resize down than up.
ringSizeGuide.printHint: Tip: print this page (Cmd/Ctrl + P) for a physical reference.
ringSizeGuide.howToSchemaName: How to measure your ring size at home
ringSizeGuide.howToSchemaDescription: Three reliable methods to measure your ring size: using an existing ring, the paper strip method, or visiting a jeweler.

faqPage.metaDescription: Answers about shipping, returns, sizing, materials, and the care of handmade beaded jewelry from Senichka.
faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subtitle: Quick answers about ordering, shipping, returns, and the care of your handmade piece.
faqPage.q_shippingTime_answer: Domestic orders ship in 1–2 business days after the piece is ready. Delivery time depends on the carrier — USPS Ground Advantage is 2–5 business days within the US. International orders take 10–20 business days depending on country and customs.
faqPage.q_returnsPolicy_answer: You can return any in-stock piece within 14 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as it is unworn and in original packaging. Made-to-order and custom pieces are final sale because each is crafted for one customer. Buyer covers return shipping.
faqPage.q_ringSizing_question: How do I find my ring size?
faqPage.q_ringSizing_answer: Use our ring size guide — it includes a printable strip and a chart for converting US, EU, UK, and JP sizes. If you have an existing ring that fits, measure its inside diameter in millimetres and look it up in the chart.
faqPage.q_materials_answer: Most pieces are sterling silver 925 or 14k gold-plated brass. Beads are Czech glass or natural gemstones (moonstone, onyx, rose quartz, etc.). Each product page lists the exact materials. If you have a metal allergy, message us — we can usually swap findings.
faqPage.q_giftWrap_question: Do you offer gift wrap or personalization?
faqPage.q_giftWrap_answer: Every order ships in a recycled gift box with a fabric pouch — no extra charge. Add a handwritten note in the cart notes field at checkout. For custom engraving on the back of a piece, message us before ordering.
faqPage.q_customsDuties_answer: No. International buyers are responsible for duties, taxes, and customs fees that may apply in your country. These are charged by your local postal service or customs office on delivery — not by us.
faqPage.q_lostPackage_question: What if my package is lost or damaged?
faqPage.q_lostPackage_answer: Track your order with the link in the shipping email. If the tracker says delivered but you have not received the package, check with neighbours and the local post office first. If it is still missing after 5 business days, contact us — we will file a claim with the carrier together.
faqPage.q_customOrders_question: Can you make a custom piece?
faqPage.q_customOrders_answer: Yes. Email us with your idea — preferred stones, size, length, occasion — and we will quote a price and timeline. Custom pieces usually take 3–6 weeks from approval, depending on materials available.
faqPage.q_careBasics_question: How do I care for my jewelry?
faqPage.q_careBasics_answer: Store pieces separately in the pouch they came in, away from moisture. Avoid contact with chlorine, perfume, lotion, and household cleaners. Polish silver gently with a microfiber cloth. See our full care guide for material-specific tips.

shippingPage.title: Shipping & returns
shippingPage.subtitle: How long an order takes, what carrier we use, and what to do if something goes wrong.
shippingPage.processingIntro: Time before your piece leaves the studio. Carrier transit time is on top.
shippingPage.carriersIntro: You can pick a carrier at checkout. Cost depends on weight and destination.
shippingPage.carrier_usps_detail: Ground Advantage 2–5 business days in the US. Default for US domestic orders.
shippingPage.carrier_fedex_detail: Express options, 1–3 business days. Recommended for higher-value pieces.
shippingPage.carrier_ups_detail: Ground 2–5 business days. Good for US business addresses.
shippingPage.carrier_dhl_detail: International 10–20 business days. Default for orders outside the US.
shippingPage.trackingBody:
When the label is printed, you receive an email with the carrier name and tracking number. Click the link to follow the package on the carrier site.

Not all scans happen in real time — it is normal for the tracker to be quiet for 24–48 hours after the first scan, especially over weekends.
shippingPage.lostBody:
If the tracker stops updating for more than 5 business days, or the package arrives damaged, contact us within 14 days of the last scan. We will open a claim with the carrier together. Most claims resolve within 2–3 weeks.

Keep the packaging if the piece is damaged — the carrier may ask for photos.
shippingPage.internationalBody: Customs duties, VAT, and import fees are the buyer’s responsibility. These are not included in the price and are not charged at checkout — your local post or customs office invoices them at delivery.

carePage.metaDescription: How to care for sterling silver, gold-plated, and gemstone handmade jewelry. Storage tips and what to avoid for long-lasting pieces.
carePage.title: Jewelry care
carePage.subtitle: A few simple habits keep handmade pieces looking new for years.
carePage.material_silver_body:
Silver tarnishes naturally over time when it reacts with air and skin oils. Wipe your piece with a microfiber cloth after wearing to remove oils and slow tarnish.

For heavier tarnish, use a dedicated silver polishing cloth. Avoid liquid silver cleaners — they are too harsh for soldered or gemstone-set pieces.
carePage.material_goldPlated_body:
The gold layer is thin and wears with repeated friction. Take pieces off before showering, swimming, exercising, or applying lotion.

Clean only with a soft dry cloth. Never use polishing compounds — they will strip the plating.
carePage.material_gemstones_body:
Most stones we use (moonstone, rose quartz, onyx) are softer than diamond and chip if struck against hard surfaces. Treat your piece like a delicate watch — take it off for housework, gym, and sleep.

Wipe with a slightly damp cloth and dry immediately. Never soak gemstone pieces — water can loosen the setting glue or damage porous stones.
carePage.avoidIntro: These shorten the life of any handmade piece.
carePage.avoid_chlorine_detail: Pools, hot tubs, and bleach corrode silver and damage stones.
carePage.avoid_perfume_detail: Apply scent and skincare before putting jewelry on, and let your skin absorb them first.
carePage.avoid_cleaners_detail: Take jewelry off before dishwashing or any cleaning task.
carePage.avoid_moisture_detail: Bathroom storage accelerates tarnish — keep pieces in a dry drawer.
carePage.storage_separateBags: Store each piece in its own pouch or compartment so chains do not tangle and stones do not scratch each other.
carePage.storage_antiTarnish: Drop an anti-tarnish strip into your jewelry box — they last about 6 months and noticeably slow silver from darkening.
carePage.storage_drySpot: Pick a dry, dark spot away from windows and radiators. Sun and heat fade some stones over time.
carePage.footnote: Treat handmade pieces gently and they last a lifetime. If anything happens, message us — we offer repairs at cost.
